title: FAP Through the Season Grief Support Group
intro: The holidays can be hard when you are grieving from loss. This support group is here to help you cope with loss—whether it's the loss of loved ones, jobs, or other difficult life changes.

sections.markdown:
Join us for coping strategies, psychoeducation, and open discussions around holidays, anniversaries, and more.

Find comfort, understanding, and healing in a safe and supportive environment.

Mondays | 12:00-1:30 PM
November 2 & 9
December 7 & 14

Location: Little Hall, 2034 Barnett Ave., FAP Classroom, lower level

For more information, contact: FAP Mainline 703.784.2570
